SELECT BOOKSET_ID booksetId,PARAM_CODE paramCode,PARAM_VALUE paramValue,PARAM_NAME paramName,REMARK remark FROM BOK_BOOKSET_EXT
AND BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
AND PARAM_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{paramCode},'%'))
AND PARAM_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{paramName},'%'))
AND REMARK LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{remark},'%'))
